user.title: Home Wallet
user.description: Connect the Home Wallet app. Create a long-lived access token in Home Assistant under your profile, then paste it here. The app uses it to show your passes and open your doors.

create_wallet.name: Create wallet
create_wallet.description: Create an access wallet (a digital pass) for a person.

delete_wallet.name: Delete wallet
delete_wallet.description: Delete a wallet. Its QR code and NFC tag stop working immediately.

rotate_wallet.name: Rotate wallet
rotate_wallet.description: Give a wallet a new secret. Old QR codes and NFC tags stop working immediately.

revoke_wallet.name: Revoke wallet
revoke_wallet.description: Deactivate a wallet without deleting it.

set_pin.name: Set PIN
set_pin.description: Set a PIN on a wallet for keypads. Leave empty to remove it.

add_door.name: Add door
add_door.description: Register a door that wallets can open.

remove_door.name: Remove door
remove_door.description: Remove a door from Home Wallet.
